audit.why: 45.18% over 363 games - the worst matchup in this slice - against a chart that gives Pantheon 2-3 and both item stages and leaves 1, 4-5 and 6 as Skill. The mirror file audits/top/pantheon__camille.json rates its stage split the same way, so both directions agree and nothing moved.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Bait his W stun BEFORE you commit', 'take it when his W is on cooldown', 'fight only when his W is down' - the whole matchup hangs on that timer and it is never given. The mirror file flagged the identical gap from his side: no cooldown appears anywhere.
audit.why: Shield Vault 13/12/11/10/9s, Comet Spear 11/10.25/9.5/8.75/8s, Aegis Assault 22/21/20/19/18s, Grand Starfall 180/165/150s. The 13s on Shield Vault at rank 1 is the number every commit on this page needs.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, mid, wants.you[1] and whys[5] now carry Shield Vault's 13s and Aegis Assault's 22s.

audit.whatIsWrong: One outright error and one missing interaction that the mirror already shipped from the other side. (1) 'His passive blocks your autos' / 'his passive auto-blocks your first hits', in three places. Mortal Will does no blocking at all - it empowers his next spell every few casts or attacks. The blocking is Aegis Assault (E), and it only blocks damage FROM THE FRONT. (2) Hookshot's landing knock-up cancels Aegis Assault outright, and that is nowhere on this page even though the mirror file states it from Pantheon's side. Camille's passive is also spelled 'Adaptive Defense' three times; it is Adaptive Defenses.
audit.why: Riot, Mortal Will: 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.' Aegis Assault: 'Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear.' Hookshot: 'leaping off and knocking up enemy champions upon landing.' audits/top/pantheon__camille.json point 4: 'Hookshot's knockup cancelling Aegis Assault is never stated.'
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, early and whys[0] move the blocking onto Aegis Assault and name its frontal-only arc; mid adds the Hookshot cancel; the passive is spelled correctly throughout.

edits.before: Pantheon owns this. His Comet Spear (Q) out-ranges your Precision Protocol and his passive auto-blocks your first hits, so don't walk up to last-hit and eat a poke spear for free. Hold your Adaptive Defense shield — he'll bait it with a Q tap, so let small pokes through and save the shield for the trade that matters. Do not E in before Level 6: his point-click W stuns you out of the grapple and gifts him an empowered Q while you're locked down. Farm at range, concede CS if you must, and stay above his all-in threshold.
edits.after: Pantheon owns this. Comet Spear (Q, 11s) out-ranges your Precision Protocol and Aegis Assault blocks damage from the FRONT, so don't walk up to last-hit and eat a poke spear for free. Hold your Adaptive Defenses shield — he'll bait it with a Q tap, so let small pokes through and save it for the trade that matters. Do not E in before Level 6: Shield Vault (W, 13s) stuns you out of the grapple and gifts him an empowered Q. Farm at range and stay above his all-in threshold.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are still his — his point-click W answers your E grapple every time, so the only way to trade is to bait the stun first, then E in and double-tap Q once W is down. Level 6 is where you breathe: Hextech Ultimatum (R) traps him in the arena so his W stun can't peel and his Q poke can't kite, and you W-slash the max-HP off him while your shield eats his combo. That R is your one clean all-in before items — take it when his W is on cooldown, not before.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are still his — Shield Vault answers your E grapple every time, so bait the stun first, then E in and double-tap Q inside its 13s. When he sets Aegis Assault (22s), your Hookshot landing knocks him up and cancels the channel outright, and it never blocked anything behind him anyway. Level 6 is where you breathe: Hextech Ultimatum traps him so his stun can't peel and his Q can't kite. Take that all-in when his W is down, not before.

edits.after: Hookshot (E) unlocks your wall-dash knock-up and attack-speed burst. Only take a wall trade when Pantheon's Shield Vault is down, then peel out on the bonus move speed before he answers. This is a clean skill phase.

notes: MIRROR REUSE: audits/top/pantheon__camille.json already established from his side that Camille's true damage is on Precision Protocol rather than Tactical Sweep and that Hookshot's landing knock-up cancels Aegis Assault. I kept both consistent here and added the cancel, which was missing on my side. The find on my side is 'his passive blocks your autos', repeated three times: Mortal Will empowers his next spell and blocks nothing. The blocking is Aegis Assault, and Riot's text says it is invulnerable to damage FROM THE FRONT only - so a Camille who wall-dashes past him is hitting the open side. That is the difference between an unbreakable wall and a 22-second cooldown you play around. NOT ASSERTED: _missing-interactions.json claims Pantheon can go untargetable through your commit and that Shield Vault cancels The Hextech Ultimatum as a channel. Riot's text for Camille's R describes a dash and an anchor with no channel and no untargetability, and the mirror declined the same two claims as tooltip-parse misfires. Logged as unverified.
